messages:
Alex: Quick note — I pushed the Slice Cost Inspector UI prototype to staging. URL in #eng-infra but tl;dr: per-invocation slices (prefix, kv-hit, batching credit, model-sku) are shown in a stacked bar so you can see which slice dominates cost. Preview: https://staging.redwood/slice-inspector :eyes:
Rina: Nice. Does it show cache reuse across chained calls? that's been the blind spot for cost allocation.
Alex: Yep — we surface a 'kv lineage' row that groups identical KV keys across invocations and attributes savings to the first writer.
Ben: How are we computing the amortized cost for prefetches? that was contentious last time.
Leah: We use a sliding-window amortization where prefetch token cost is split across consumers in the next 5m by access count. Implementation note in the PR.
Kai: Sampling/volume concern: adding per-token slice details for all invocations will blow telemetry. can we sample or roll this out behind a flag?
Alex: Absolutely. default = sampled at 0.1% global. rollout flag = `slice_inspector_sampling` so we can enable for canaries/enterprise tenants.
Rina: For chargeback we still need deterministic numbers. sampling makes invoices messy. any plan for exact accounting?
Ben: We keep the billing pipeline unchanged (coarse token meter). Slice Inspector is for attribution + debugging only. Billing numbers come from authoritative meter.
Leah: Also adding an export endpoint for reconciled slices so finance can run offline aggregation if they opt-in to higher fidelity (costly telemetry).
Kai: Can we see a quick snippet of the telemetry query/aggregation so I can validate performance?
Alex: Paste from staging ingestion job: ```sql
-- aggregate slices per invocation
SELECT
  invocation_id,
  model_sku,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT slice_type) AS slices,
  SUM(tokens) AS tokens_total,
  SUM(tokens * token_weight) AS token_cost_estimate
FROM slice_events
WHERE ingested_at >= now() - INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY invocation_id, model_sku
```
Rina: Looks fine but we need indexes on `ingested_at` + `invocation_id` to avoid full scans. also consider pre-aggregated daily partitions.
Ben: UX question: how do we surface uncertainty from sampling? a small badge? a confidence band on the stacked bar?
Leah: Thinking: show a tiny % sampled label and a tooltip that explains sampling rate + expected variance. also a 'recompute with full fidelity' button for selected time windows (costs money).
Kai: For rollout, can we gate `recompute with full fidelity` to orgs with Enterprise flag to avoid abuse?
Alex: yes — permission checked in API via `org_feature_flags`. deploy-bot: "deployed slice-inspector-api to staging (rev 8a4bf), sampling hook enabled"
Rina: Small nit — when a slice is zero-cost due to cache hit, we still display a tiny bar. could we collapse zero-cost rows to simplify view?
Ben: I like seeing them collapsed by default with an expand chevron. keeps the main bars focused.
Leah: I'll update the CSS so collapsed rows show summary counts.
Kai: One more ask: include a per-model unit-econ snapshot (tokens-per-request, avg latency, inferred $/invocation) so product can prioritize model swaps.
Alex: Good call. adding a right-hand card with per-model metrics and a 'simulate quantization' slider that recomputes estimated savings locally in the browser.
Rina: For telemetry owners: would love a small endpoint to pull raw slice events for a tenant for 7 days (paginated). debug use only.
Ben: +1. add rate limits and audit logging.
Leah: I'll file follow-up tasks: 1) sampling doc + variance calc; 2) staging perf indexes; 3) UI collapse behavior; 4) enterprise recompute perms; 5) debug export with rate limits.
Alex: Perfect. let's do a small canary next week (5% orgs) and monitor ingestion and query P99. thanks all :rocket:
